pages.title: Home automation
pages.body:
Bring lighting, climate, curtains and access into a considered home specification. Explore the controls and interfaces that can make everyday living more comfortable.

Home automation connects the functions you use every day. Start by defining the rooms, controls and ways you want to interact with them, then confirm the appropriate devices, protocols and installation requirements for your project.

Discuss your specification

Original source category

pages.title: Guest room management
pages.body:
Guest Room Management Systems coordinate room functions such as lighting, climate and guest controls. Explore source-listed room controllers and operator panels for your hotel specification.

A Guest Room Management System (GRMS) brings individual room functions into a coordinated design. Define the desired guest experience and operational requirements, then review the exact room-controller model, I/O needs and integration boundaries.

Discuss your specification

Original source category

pages.title: Building management
pages.body:
Building Management Systems bring monitoring and control into one building-wide approach. Explore automation servers, I/O controllers, gateways and visualization tools.

A Building Management System (BMS) connects building services through controllers, field devices and management software. Define the equipment, points, network protocols and monitoring needs before choosing an architecture. Compatibility and capacity should be confirmed for each exact model.

Discuss your specification

Original source category

pages.title: Lighting control
pages.body:
Explore DALI controllers, sensors, dimmers and room controls. Build a lighting specification around how your spaces are used.

Lighting control combines user input, sensors and controller logic to create the intended lighting behavior. Confirm the luminaires, drivers, addressing, control zones and electrical requirements before selecting devices. Source-mentioned DALI support does not establish compatibility with every driver or controller.

Discuss your specification
